review_candidates.title: Systems Engineer (Infrastructure)
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Reporting to the Enterprise Technology Manager, you will play a key role in maintaining and enhancing our core infrastructure, cloud platforms, Microsoft 365 environment, and security posture. This is a broad technical role covering Windows and Linux administration, AWS and Azure cloud services, networking, automation, security remediation, and infrastructure-as-code. eligibility_evidence: Requirements: must be an Australian Citizen What you’ll do Administer and support Windows Server and Linux environments, ensuring systems remain secure, patched, and highly available.
What You'll Bring Must be an Australian Citizen.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Service Stream is seeking a hands-on Systems Engineer (Infrastructure) to join our Enterprise Technology team. Requirements: must be an Australian Citizen What you’ll do Administer and support Windows Server and Linux environments, ensuring systems remain secure, patched, and highly available. 3+ years' experience in systems administration or infrastructure engineering within a medium to large enterprise environment. Hands-on experience supporting Windows Server, Linux, cloud platforms, Microsoft 365, networking, patching, monitoring, incident response, and technical documentation. Hands-on experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, ARM templates, PowerShell, Python, Ansible, or similar automation and IaC tools.
